_comment: The display-order rules of the menus, in one place. Each rule is an ordered list; a name outside a list sorts after every listed name. Read by the Lua drivers through menu.row_order (generated into _shared/lua/menu/row_order_data.lua by tools/codegen/codegen-menu-row-order.cjs). tools/test/test-menu-row-order-single-source.cjs refuses a hard-coded copy of any of these orders in a driver.

hotstring_group_classes.description: Order of the hotstring group classes in a menu: the classes of menu_manifest.json hotstring_groups, listed by the order of their members.

hotstring_config_categories.description: Display order of the built-in categories in the hotstrings configuration window; it matches the menu and the AHK driver.

llm_menu_rows.description: Order of the AI submenu rows a native menu registers handlers for when menu_manifest.json llm_menu cannot be read. The gate pins it to the manifest rows of the macOS driver.

model_tag_emoji.description: Order of the capability emoji after a model name in the model list.

menu_chord_modifiers.description: Order of the modifiers in the shortcut titles of the macOS menus (shortcut_utils); the bindings' own labels use the canonical chord order.
